title.zh: Vercel：开源模型吃下71.5% Token，中国模型正在为美国推理服务商创造大量生意
title.en: Vercel：开源模型吃下71.5% Token，中国模型正在为美国推理服务商创造大量生意

current_state.zh: Vercel's September AI Gateway data shows open-source models processing 71.5% of tokens for just 23% of spend—led by DeepSeek—while roughly 70% of estimated fees for Chinese models now accrue to US inference providers, up from under 10% in December 2025.
